37.16.s: mekhalādīni cet plaveran punar upanayeta || vimocanīyān homān hutvānyaṃ brāhmaṇam anūcānam upaveśyodapātraṃ cāparājitena niṣkramya vāso yajñopavītādi dattvābhyukṣyācamyāpāṃ sūktaiḥ pavitraiś ca saṃprokṣya priyaṃ mā kṛṇu deveṣv iti yajñopavītaṃ dattvā vimṛgvarīṃ mā naḥ paścād iti dvābhyāṃ prāṅmukha upaviśya mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitrī śāntisūktaṃ brahma jajñānaṃ yad asmṛty anumatiḥ sarvam iti juhuyād abhyātānaiś ca ||
37.16.d: मेखलादीनि चेत् प्लवेरन् पुनर् उपनयेत ॥ विमोचनीयान् होमान् हुत्वान्यं ब्राह्मणम् अनूचानम् उपवेश्योदपात्रं चापराजितेन निष्क्रम्य वासो यज्ञोपवीतादि दत्त्वाभ्युक्ष्याचम्यापां सूक्तैः पवित्रैश् च संप्रोक्ष्य प्रियं मा कृणु देवेष्व् इति यज्ञोपवीतं दत्त्वा विमृग्वरीं मा नः पश्चाद् इति द्वाभ्यां प्राङ्मुख उपविश्य महाव्याहृतिभिः सावित्री शान्तिसूक्तं ब्रह्म जज्ञानं यद् अस्मृत्य् अनुमतिः सर्वम् इति जुहुयाद् अभ्यातानैश् च ॥
37.16.m: If the girdle and other [accoutrements] should float away, he should initiate [the boy] again. Having offered the discharge oblations, having seated another learned brahmin, and having gone out with the undefeated water-pot, having given a garment, sacred thread, and the like, having sprinkled [himself], sipped water, and consecrated [him] with the hymns to the waters and purifying [verses], having given the sacred thread with the words, 'Make me dear among the gods...', and having sat facing east with the two [hymns], 'The cleansing one...' and 'Do not behind us...', he should offer oblations with the great Vyāhṛtis, the Sāvitrī, the propitiatory hymn, 'The sacred word first born...', 'Whatever has been forgotten...', and 'Anumati, all...', and with the Abhyātāna formulas.

37.17.s: atha yatraitan mekhalā prapatati jīrṇā vā syāt tāṃ sāvitryoddhṛtyāntaṃ kṛtvā śāntyudakena saṃprokṣya mahāvyāhṛtibhiḥ sāvitrī śāntisūktaṃ brahma jajñānaṃ ye triṣaptā idāvatsarāya ghṛtena tvāgniṃ brhūma iti ||
37.17.d: अथ यत्रैतन् मेखला प्रपतति जीर्णा वा स्यात् तां सावित्र्योद्धृत्यान्तं कृत्वा शान्त्युदकेन संप्रोक्ष्य महाव्याहृतिभिः सावित्री शान्तिसूक्तं ब्रह्म जज्ञानं ये त्रिषप्ता इदावत्सराय घृतेन त्वाग्निं ब्र्हूम इति ॥
37.17.m: Now, where the girdle falls off or becomes worn out: having taken it off with the Sāvitrī, made an end [to its use], and sprinkled [the new one] with propitiatory water, [he should offer oblations] with the great Vyāhṛtis, the Sāvitrī, the propitiatory hymn, 'The sacred word first born...', 'Those thrice seven...', 'For the Idāvatsara...', and 'With ghee we [praise] you, Agni...'

37.18.s: caturthyām ahutāyāṃ yadi ghaṭodakaṃ naśyeta tathaiva punar ānīya śaṃ no devīr iheta devīr ity anumantryāmbayo yanty āpo hi ṣṭhā śaṃ no devīr iti saṃpātya vyāhṛtyā saṃnatyā ca juhuyāt āpo bhṛgvaṅgirorūpam apāṃ puṣpam ity udakumbham abhimantrayet || vāso dakṣiṇā ||
37.18.d: चतुर्थ्याम् अहुतायां यदि घटोदकं नश्येत तथैव पुनर् आनीय शं नो देवीर् इहेत देवीर् इत्य् अनुमन्त्र्याम्बयो यन्त्य् आपो हि ष्ठा शं नो देवीर् इति संपात्य व्याहृत्या संनत्या च जुहुयात् आपो भृग्वङ्गिरोरूपम् अपां पुष्पम् इत्य् उदकुम्भम् अभिमन्त्रयेत् ॥ वासो दक्षिणा ॥
37.18.m: If, while the fourth [oblation] has not been offered, the jar-water should be lost, having brought [water] again in the same manner, having consecrated it with 'May the divine [waters] be auspicious for us...' and 'Here, O divine [waters]...', having poured it with 'The mothers go...', 'The waters indeed are...', and 'May the divine [waters] be auspicious for us...', he should make an offering with a Vyāhṛti and a Saṃnati; he should recite over the water-jar the verses, 'Waters are the form of Bhṛgu and Aṅgiras...' and 'Flower of the waters...'. A garment is the sacrificial fee.

37.19.s: atha yasyāsamāpte karmaṇy udapātraṃ pravarteta tad anumantrayate
37.19.d: अथ यस्यासमाप्ते कर्मण्य् उदपात्रं प्रवर्तेत तद् अनुमन्त्रयते
37.19.m: Now, in the case of one whose water-pot rolls over when the rite is not yet finished, he recites over it:

37.19.s: yad udapātraṃ pravartate brahmaṇāsthāpitaṃ mahat | sthānāc cyutaṃ pravartitaṃ tan me vahatu kilbiṣam || ity āsthāpayati ||
37.19.d: यद् उदपात्रं प्रवर्तते ब्रह्मणास्थापितं महत् । स्थानाच् च्युतं प्रवर्तितं तन् मे वहतु किल्बिषम् ॥ इत्य् आस्थापयति ॥
37.19.m: 'The great water-pot that rolls over, placed by the sacred word, / fallen from its place, rolling: let it carry away my guilt.' With these words he sets it up.

37.19.s: pūraṇena pūrayitvā punaḥ pūrṇam ity etayā |
37.19.d: पूरणेन पूरयित्वा पुनः पूर्णम् इत्य् एतया ।
37.19.m: Having filled it with a filling [mantra], with this [verse beginning with], 'Filled again...':

37.19.s: punaḥ pūrṇam idaṃ pātraṃ brahmaṇāsthāpayāmasi | viśvais tad devair abhiṣṭutam ||
37.19.d: पुनः पूर्णम् इदं पात्रं ब्रह्मणास्थापयामसि । विश्वैस् तद् देवैर् अभिष्टुतम् ॥
37.19.m: 'This vessel, filled again, we set up by the sacred word, / praised by all the gods.'

37.19.s: ūrjaṃ puṣṭaṃ dadhātu no rāyas poṣaṃ śriyam āyuḥ | mayi karma samṛdhyatām iti ||
37.19.d: ऊर्जं पुष्टं दधातु नो रायस् पोषं श्रियम् आयुः । मयि कर्म समृध्यताम् इति ॥
37.19.m: 'May it place in us vigor, nourishment, increase of wealth, fortune, and long life; / may the rite succeed in me.' [With these words he sets it up].

37.20.s: atha cet prabhajyeta bhūmir bhūmim agād ity anumantryānyataram āhṛtya yady antarikṣe punar maitv indriyam ity anumantrya vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ud enaṃ vaiśvānaro raśmibhir iti juhuyāt sā tatra prāyaścittiḥ ||
37.20.d: अथ चेत् प्रभज्येत भूमिर् भूमिम् अगाद् इत्य् अनुमन्त्र्यान्यतरम् आहृत्य यद्य् अन्तरिक्षे पुनर् मैत्व् इन्द्रियम् इत्य् अनुमन्त्र्य वैश्वानरो न ऊतय उद् एनं वैश्वानरो रश्मिभिर् इति जुहुयात् सा तत्र प्रायश्चित्तिः ॥
37.20.m: Now, if it should break, having recited over it, 'Earth has gone to earth...', having brought another [pot], and having recited over it, 'If in the intermediate space...', and 'May my faculty return to me...', he should offer oblations with 'Vaiśvānara for our aid...' and 'Upward this Vaiśvānara with his rays...'. That is the expiation in that case.

38.1.s: oṃ brahmakūrcavidhiṃ puṇyaṃ saṃkṣepād vacmy asaṃśayam | pāvanānāṃ paraṃ yo hi pāvanaṃ tapasāṃ tapaḥ ||
38.1.d: ओं ब्रह्मकूर्चविधिं पुण्यं संक्षेपाद् वच्म्य् असंशयम् । पावनानां परं यो हि पावनं तपसां तपः ॥
38.1.m: Om. I declare concisely and without doubt the holy procedure for the Brahmakūrca, which is the supreme purifier among purifiers, the austerity of austerities.

38.1.s: snātvā śuciḥ śucau deśe gomayenāvasecite | vastreṇa saṃhite cāpi sitapuṣpaiḥ prapūjite ||
38.1.d: स्नात्वा शुचिः शुचौ देशे गोमयेनावसेचिते । वस्त्रेण संहिते चापि सितपुष्पैः प्रपूजिते ॥
38.1.m: Having bathed and become clean in a clean place sprinkled with cow dung, covered with a cloth, and worshipped with white flowers;

38.1.s: ahorātrositaḥ kṣāntaḥ pavitrātmā prapāvanaḥ | śuklavāsāḥ sugandhiḥ prāg upaviṣṭaḥ kuśāsane ||
38.1.d: अहोरात्रोसितः क्षान्तः पवित्रात्मा प्रपावनः । शुक्लवासाः सुगन्धिः प्राग् उपविष्टः कुशासने ॥
38.1.m: having fasted for a day and night, patient, pure in soul, thoroughly purifying, dressed in white garments, fragrant, seated facing east on a kuśa-grass mat;

38.1.s: gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam | āharet tāmrapātre tu śakṛn mūtraṃ tv abhūgatam ||
38.1.d: गोमूत्रं गोमयं क्षीरं दधि सर्पिः कुशोदकम् । आहरेत् ताम्रपात्रे तु शकृन् मूत्रं त्व् अभूगतम् ॥
38.1.m: he should collect cow urine, cow dung, milk, curd, clarified butter, and kuśa-water in a copper vessel; but the dung and urine must not have fallen on the ground.

38.1.s: gomūtraṃ nīlavarṇāyāḥ kṛṣṇāyā gomayaṃ tathā | payas tu tāmravarṇāyāḥ śvetāya āhared dadhi ||
38.1.d: गोमूत्रं नीलवर्णायाः कृष्णाया गोमयं तथा । पयस् तु ताम्रवर्णायाः श्वेताय आहरेद् दधि ॥
38.1.m: [He should collect] the cow urine from a tawny cow, the cow dung likewise from a black one, but milk from a copper-colored one; he should take curd from a white cow;

38.1.s: kapilāyā ghṛtaṃ grāhyam alābhe syāt tu pañcamam ||
38.1.d: कपिलाया घृतं ग्राह्यम् अलाभे स्यात् तु पञ्चमम् ॥
38.1.m: clarified butter should be taken from a brown cow; in the absence [of a specific one], [any cow] may be the fifth.

38.2.s: gomūtraikapalaṃ dadyād aṅguṣṭhāgraṃ tu gomayam | kṣīrasya sapta dadhnas tu trīṇy ekaikaṃ ghṛtāmbhasoḥ ||
38.2.d: गोमूत्रैकपलं दद्याद् अङ्गुष्ठाग्रं तु गोमयम् । क्षीरस्य सप्त दध्नस् तु त्रीण्य् एकैकं घृताम्भसोः ॥
38.2.m: He should give one pala of cow urine, but cow dung [in the amount of] the tip of a thumb; seven [palas] of milk, but three of curd, and one each of clarified butter and water.

38.2.s: gāyatryāhṛtya gomūtraṃ gandhadvāreti gomayam | ā pyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi ||
38.2.d: गायत्र्याहृत्य गोमूत्रं गन्धद्वारेति गोमयम् । आ प्यायस्वेति च क्षीरं दधिक्राव्णेति वै दधि ॥
38.2.m: Having collected the cow urine with the Gāyatrī, the cow dung with 'Having the gate of fragrance...', the milk with 'Swell up...', and the curd with 'With Dadhikrāvan...';

38.2.s: tejo 'si śukram ity ajyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam | saptapattrās tu ye darbhā achinnāgrāḥ samāyutāḥ ||
38.2.d: तेजो ऽसि शुक्रम् इत्य् अज्यं देवस्य त्वा कुशोदकम् । सप्तपत्त्रास् तु ये दर्भा अछिन्नाग्राः समायुताः ॥
38.2.m: the clarified butter with 'You are brilliance, bright...', and the kuśa-water with 'Of the god...'; and whichever darbha blades have seven leaves, unbroken tips, and are joined together:

38.2.s: taiḥ samuddhṛtya hotavyaṃ devatābhyo yathākarmam | agnaye svāhā somāya prajāpataya ity api ||
38.2.d: तैः समुद्धृत्य होतव्यं देवताभ्यो यथाकर्मम् । अग्नये स्वाहा सोमाय प्रजापतय इत्य् अपि ॥
38.2.m: having scooped [the mixture] up with these, oblations should be offered to the deities according to the rite: 'To Agni svāhā', 'To Soma', and also 'To Prajāpati';

38.2.s: bṛhaspate ati yad idaṃ viṣṇur itīti ca | mānastokena gāyatryā etaiś ca juhuyāt tataḥ ||
38.2.d: बृहस्पते अति यद् इदं विष्णुर् इतीति च । मानस्तोकेन गायत्र्या एतैश् च जुहुयात् ततः ॥
38.2.m: and with 'O Bṛhaspati, whatever...', 'This Viṣṇu...', with 'Do not harm our child...', and with the Gāyatrī; then he should make oblations with these.

38.2.s: praṇavena praṇavenaiva pibec ca praṇavena tu | hotavyaṃ praṇavenaiva pibec ca praṇavena tu ||
38.2.d: प्रणवेन प्रणवेनैव पिबेच् च प्रणवेन तु । होतव्यं प्रणवेनैव पिबेच् च प्रणवेन तु ॥
38.2.m: With the syllable Om, with the syllable Om alone he should drink, and with the syllable Om [offer]; oblations should be made with the syllable Om alone, and he should drink with the syllable Om.

38.3.s: madhyamena palāśasya padmapattreṇa vā pibet | api vā tāmrapātreṇa hutaśeṣaṃ viśuddhaye ||
38.3.d: मध्यमेन पलाशस्य पद्मपत्त्रेण वा पिबेत् । अपि वा ताम्रपात्रेण हुतशेषं विशुद्धये ॥
38.3.m: He should drink the remainder of the oblation for purification with the middle leaf of a palāśa or with a lotus leaf, or even with a copper vessel.

38.3.s: yat tvagasthigataṃ pāpaṃ dehe tiṣṭhati dehinām | brahmakūrco dahet sarvaṃ pradīpto 'gnir ivendhanam ||
38.3.d: यत् त्वगस्थिगतं पापं देहे तिष्ठति देहिनाम् । ब्रह्मकूर्चो दहेत् सर्वं प्रदीप्तो ऽग्निर् इवेन्धनम् ॥
38.3.m: Whatever sin residing in skin and bone dwells in the bodies of embodied beings, the Brahmakūrca consumes it all, like a blazing fire consumes firewood.

38.3.s: trayodaśyādicaturṣu triḥsnānākṣārabhojanam | pañcadaśyāṃ pañcagavyaṃ sopavāsaṃ mahāphalam ||
38.3.d: त्रयोदश्यादिचतुर्षु त्रिःस्नानाक्षारभोजनम् । पञ्चदश्यां पञ्चगव्यं सोपवासं महाफलम् ॥
38.3.m: Bathing thrice daily and eating non-pungent food for the four [days] starting with the thirteenth; taking the five products of the cow on the fifteenth while fasting yields great fruit.

38.3.s: abhojyābhakṣyaśūdrānnabhakṣaṇe vedavikraye | pratigrahe kālamantrahīne home dyumaithune ||
38.3.d: अभोज्याभक्ष्यशूद्रान्नभक्षणे वेदविक्रये । प्रतिग्रहे कालमन्त्रहीने होमे द्युमैथुने ॥
38.3.m: In the case of eating forbidden food, uneatable things, or the food of a Śūdra; in selling the Veda; in improper acceptance of gifts; in a fire offering deficient in time or mantra; in daytime sexual intercourse;

38.3.s: bālatve yat kṛtaṃ caiva yuvā vṛddhavayās tathā | mātāpitṛkṛtaṃ caiva tat kṣaṇād eva nirdahet ||
38.3.d: बालत्वे यत् कृतं चैव युवा वृद्धवयास् तथा । मातापितृकृतं चैव तत् क्षणाद् एव निर्दहेत् ॥
38.3.m: and whatever was done in childhood, youth, or old age, and also that done by parents: it burns [that sin] away that very instant.

38.3.s: māsemāse prayuñjānodevalokam avāpnuyāt | ardhamāseardhamāse ca ṛṣīṇāṃ lokam uttamam ||
38.3.d: मासेमासे प्रयुञ्जानोदेवलोकम् अवाप्नुयात् । अर्धमासेअर्धमासे च ऋषीणां लोकम् उत्तमम् ॥
38.3.m: Practicing it month after month, he would attain the world of the gods; and half-month after half-month, the highest world of the seers.

38.3.s: ṣaḍrātre caiva ṣaḍrātre brahmalokam anāmayam | aharahaḥ prayuñjānaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati ||
38.3.d: षड्रात्रे चैव षड्रात्रे ब्रह्मलोकम् अनामयम् । अहरहः प्रयुञ्जानः परं ब्रह्माधिगच्छति ॥
38.3.m: And every six nights, the healthy world of Brahmā; practicing it day after day, he reaches the supreme Brahman.

38.3.s: anena vidhinaiveṣṭvā devatarpaṇapūrvakam | brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ hy etat pavitraṃ paramaṃ hitam ||
38.3.d: अनेन विधिनैवेष्ट्वा देवतर्पणपूर्वकम् । ब्रह्मणा निर्मितं ह्य् एतत् पवित्रं परमं हितम् ॥
38.3.m:
Having sacrificed by this very rule, preceded by a water libation to the gods —
for this was fashioned by Brahmā as supreme, purifying, and beneficial.
